description: This Go source file contains functions related to language translation prompts, including functions for formatting prompts in Chinese, Japanese, and a generic style, as well as building a glossary prompt section.

methods.name: prettyLanguageLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable language label for given language code, with special cases for 'en', 'zh-CN', and 'ja-JP'.

methods.name: translationPrompt
methods.description: Constructs a translation prompt string based on source and target languages, utilizing different templates for Chinese, Japanese, or a generic format, and incorporating a glossary.

methods.name: buildGlossaryPrompt
methods.description: Builds a string section for the glossary entries to be included in the translation prompt.
